headword: {品質保証|ひんしつほしょう}

definitions.explanation: The systematic process of ensuring that a product or service meets defined standards of quality, or a formal guarantee that a product will perform as expected. Widely used in manufacturing and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}⟦{部門|ぶもん}→部門：14406_bumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was assigned to the quality assurance department.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This product comes with a quality guarantee.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たさない→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Products that do not meet quality assurance standards cannot be shipped.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧ (quality) and ⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧ (guarantee/assurance). Used extensively in manufacturing, business, and product contexts. In corporate settings, often abbreviated as QA. Japan's manufacturing culture places great emphasis on quality assurance processes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}⟦{部門|ぶもん}→部門：14406_bumon⟧: quality assurance department
- {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: quality assurance system
- {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}{書|しょ}: certificate of quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}{管理|かんり}→品質管理：21220_hinshitsukanri⟧ — quality control (QC); focuses on inspection and control processes
- ⟦{保証|ほしょう}{書|しょ}→保証書：09627_hoshousho⟧ — warranty certificate; a document guaranteeing a product
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ — quality inspection; the testing stage specifically
